rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with an expanded good-quality blastocyst and the provided 3AA grade, but it includes image-specific details that may be overinterpreted or not clearly verifiable from a single image (e.g., exact ICM location, debris, absence of collapse artifact).
Thoroughly integrates age, AMH, ovarian response, diagnosis, endometrium, sperm parameters, BMI, lifestyle, and first-cycle status with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a clear link from embryo quality and patient factors to prognosis; minor issues include somewhat confident quantitative adjustments and a few speculative inferences.

Largely aligned on SET, blastocyst grading, and general counseling, but some recommendations are not guideline-first or are overextended for this scenario (e.g., ERA, thrombophilia/immunologic workup after a single failed transfer, broad endorsement of PGT-A/banking).

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer management and future cycle review, especially around SET, luteal support, and trigger/maturity review; slightly reduced by inclusion of lower-yield ancillary testing suggestions.
